verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only shows generic OpenAI-compatible API claims (base URL swap, chat completions) and unrelated features (priority tiers, GPU deployment, image/video models) but never mentions function/tool calling, parallel tool calls, or multi-step agentic tool use, nor any benchmark/community report on tool-calling fidelity. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a `tools`/`function_call` parameter, evidence of parallel tool call support, and any hands-on or benchmark confirmation that tool calling works reliably in agent loops.
